data.name: Aymanah
data.gender_notes: Aymanah is used as a unisex name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Aymanah is derived from the Arabic word 'Ayman', which means 'right hand' or 'right side'. In Islamic tradition, it represents the righteous and grateful individual who is always close to Allah. The name Aymanah carries the meaning “Righteous, Grateful” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in English, Urdu, Hindi. Parents who choose Aymanah usually hope their child will grow to embody righteous, grateful and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.spiritual_meaning: To be close to Allah and live a life of righteousness and gratitude.
data.etymology: Aymanah belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Righteous, Grateful.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Aymanah total 9, giving a life-path number of 9. Number 9 is linked with Mars and with the qualities of compassion, idealism and generosity.

in_arabic.name: أيمنة
in_arabic.long_meaning: أيمنة هي اسم علم مؤنث مشتق من الجذر العربي أَيْمَنَ وَيْمَن، ويحمل معنى المنعمه المباركه، وقد ورد في القرآن الكريم في سورة مريم، ويعتبر من الأسماء المقدسة في التراث الإسلامي، وله دلالة روحية كبيرة في الثقافة الإسلامية

in_urdu.name: ایمنہ
in_urdu.long_meaning: ایمنہ نام کا مطلب ہے ممنوعہ مبارک اور یہ نام عربی جڑ سے لیا گیا ہے، اس نام کی دلالت روحانی اور ثقافتی طور پر بہت اہم ہے، اور یہ نام برادری کے لیے مبارک اور خوشی کا باعث ہے

in_hindi.name: अयमना
in_hindi.long_meaning: अयमना नाम का अर्थ है मुबारक और आशीर्वाद और यह नाम अरबी मूल से लिया गया है, इस नाम का महत्व आध्यात्मिक और सांस्कृतिक रूप से बहुत बड़ा है, और यह नाम समुदाय के लिए आशीर्वाद और खुशी का स्रोत है

in_pashto.name: ایمنه
in_pashto.long_meaning: ایمنه نوم معنی دی چې ممنوعه مبارک، دا نوم عربي ریښې څخه اخیستل شوی، دا نوم د روحي او کلتوري لحاظ څخه ډېر مهم دی، او دا نوم د समودای لپاره مبارک او خوشی ده

data.cultural_impact: The name Aymanah carries a rich cultural significance for many Muslims. In Arabic culture, the hand is often used as a metaphor for support, trustworthiness, and strength. Thus, the name Aymanah is often given to girls believed to possess these virtues, inspiring them to live up to the namesake.
data.spiritual_significance: In the spiritual realm, Aymanah represents the individual who is constantly close to Allah, just as a right hand is always close to the left hand. Through this name, Muslims are encouraged to be steadfast in their faith and trust in Allah's guidance, and to seekHis pleasure above all else. Additionally, in the context of Hadith, Aymanah is also mentioned as the name of a woman who accompanied the Prophet Muhammad and his wife, Aisha, during their emigration to Medina. As a result, the name carries a deep historical and religious significance for many Muslims.
data.spiritual_symbolism: Aymanah: A trust or guarantee from Allah, signifying divine protection and steadfast faith. The name instills a sense of serenity and confidence, reflecting one's unwavering commitment to the divine will.

islamic_reference.note: Traditional Islamic name with deep spiritual significance in Islamic culture

historical_references.reference: Historical records show that Aymanah was mentioned in the Hadith as a name of a companion of the Prophet Muhammad. The name Aymanah carried significant weight in that era.
historical_references.context: The name Aymanah is associated with a companion of the Prophet Muhammad who was known for her piety and devotion.

modern_usage.modern_context: The name Aymanah remains relevant in modern Muslim society, representing a bridge between traditional Islamic values and contemporary life. It is widely discussed on digital platforms and continues to be a popular choice for families seeking meaningful Islamic names.
